0.value:
clean~ takes subsonics off the bottom of a signal and fizz off the top.

condition~ is the same node.

THE CHANNEL STRIP'S HYGIENE STAGE:
The intended place is source -> fader~ -> clean~ -> place~ -> audio_out~. It exists for when a bowed 5 Hz, or a low mode blooming out of a resonator, is eating headroom without being music.

Physical models are the reason. They produce energy well below what anything can reproduce, and that energy is real - it moves the meters and steals the loudness - but nobody hears it. At the other end, hard folding and crushing leave a fizz near the top of the range.

WHAT IT DOES:
A high-pass at 'low cut' and a low-pass at 'high cut', each 24 dB per octave (fourth-order Butterworth), flat and resonance-free between. Not an instrument and not an EQ: it removes what was never meant, and passes everything that was. Pull 'low cut' down when the subsonics ARE the material.

SYNTAX:
clean~ [low cut] [high cut]

EXAMPLE:
clean~ 30 12000

INPUTS:

left in / right in:
The signal. With nothing patched to 'right in', the right outlet carries the filtered left signal.

low cut:
The high-pass frequency, 5 to 300 Hz. Default 25.

high cut:
The low-pass frequency, 1000 to 20000 Hz. Default 16000.

Both are inlets, so a patch can move them.

bypass:
Ticked, the signal passes through untouched.

OUTPUTS:

left out / right out:
The cleaned signal.

RELATED:
one_euro~ smooths a control signal before it is heard.
